lines.1: 「I'm free tomorrow and the day after. Want to go out to the mountain streams in Tanzawa?」
lines.3: 「The water's crystal clear, and there are wild char and yamame trout swimming around, so the fishing's great. The scenery's beautiful too... I thought I'd like to see it with you.」
lines.5: 「Good. Then let's get to sleep so we're ready for tomorrow.」
lines.10: 「And here I thought we'd finally get to have some fun outside together.」
lines.12: 「Come on, Otome. There are plenty of things we can do indoors.」
lines.13: 「True. What should we do? Want to go bowling? Karaoke would be fine too.」
lines.15: 「Yeah. And most importantly, something you'll enjoy too.」
lines.17: 「What is it? Ahaha, now I'm looking forward to it.」
lines.25: It's her day off, too. Otome must be taking it hard.
lines.26: And it's coming down harder than yesterday.
lines.27: That's summer on the Pacific coast for you.
lines.30: She wasn't in there frightened again, was she?
lines.36: 「...Somehow, your stare is creepier than the thunder right now.」
lines.46: I looked at myself in the mirror.
lines.47: Hmm. My skin had quite a healthy glow.
lines.49: ...The weather, on the other hand, was in terrible shape.
lines.50: Were we going to be stuck indoors again today?
lines.54: I just had to keep at it.
lines.56: 「Welcome back, Otome. Today wasn't club practice, it was the disciplinary committee's summer duty day, right?」
lines.57: 「Yeah. The rain got me a little wet.」
lines.59: I'd dry her off for her.
lines.62: 「It looks right when I towel you off, but not the other way around, does it?」
lines.65: She sure was particular about that.
lines.66: 「All this bad weather is enough to bring anyone down.」
lines.67: 「Then how about we do something fun?」
lines.68: 「Hm? What did you have in mind--a game of chess?」
